description: autogel ladder library. sizes: top -> bottom of the gel. masses: per band for reference_load (vendor datasheet). verified=true means sizes (and masses, if given) were checked against the vendor source on the 'checked' date. Always compare with the datasheet of your lot.

ladders.name: NEB Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus (N0550)

reference_load.text: Mass values are for 1 µg/lane (100 µg/ml: 10 µl)

ladders.note: Band 15 is the 500/517 bp doublet (co-migrates). Recommended load 5-10 µl (0.5-1 µg).

ladders.name: NEB 1 kb Plus (N3200)

reference_load.text: Mass values are for 1 µg/lane (stock 1 mg/ml, dilute before loading)

ladders.note: Formerly '2-Log DNA Ladder'. Band 15 is the 500/517 bp doublet.

ladders.name: NEB 1 kb (N3232)

reference_load.text: Mass values are for 0.5 µg/gel lane

ladders.note: Last band = 517 + 500 bp (21 + 21 ng), co-migrating on agarose.

ladders.name: NEB 100 bp (N3231)
ladders.note: Band 8 is the 500/517 bp doublet.

ladders.name: Invitrogen 1 Kb Plus (10787018, 100-15,000 bp)

reference_load.text: ng per 0.5 µg (1 µl of the 0.5 µg/µl stock)

ladders.note: Current formulation (since 2017, 18 fragments; the older 10787 had a 12 kb top band). Sizes and the 500 ng load from sheet MAN0000898; masses (ng/0.5 µg) from the band image on the product page (not in the PDF sheet). The same values were used by the GelGenie authors (Aquilina et al., Nat Commun 2025).

ladders.name: GeneRuler 100 bp Plus (SM0321)
ladders.note: Band count (14) and range (100-3000 bp) match the product page; individual sizes and masses not yet checked against the manual.

ladders.name: GeneRuler 100 bp (SM0241)
ladders.note: Band count (10) and range (100-1000 bp) match the product page; masses not yet checked.

ladders.name: PageRuler Prestained (26616)
ladders.note: Apparent MW, calibrated in Tris-glycine (Laemmli) SDS-PAGE; can shift in other buffer/gel systems.

ladders.name: PageRuler Plus Prestained (26619)
ladders.note: Apparent MW in Tris-glycine SDS-PAGE (4-20 %, 8-16 %, 10-20 %, 8-15 %). Orange reference bands ~70 and 25 kDa, green 10 kDa. For Bis-Tris (MOPS/MES) or Tris-acetate gels use the matching entry: the same bands run at other apparent sizes. In gels < 10 % the small bands may run with the dye front. Lot-to-lot ~5 %.
ladders.source: Thermo Fisher user guide MAN0011773 Rev. C.01 (PageRuler Plus Prestained Protein Ladder)

ladders.name: PageRuler Plus Prestained (26619), Bis-Tris MOPS
ladders.note: The same ladder as 26619, apparent MW in NuPAGE Bis-Tris gels with MOPS running buffer (4-12 %, 10 %, 12 %). In 10 % and 12 % gels the 10 kDa band runs off. Lot-to-lot ~5 %.
ladders.source: Thermo Fisher user guide MAN0011773 Rev. C.01, migration table

ladders.name: PageRuler Plus Prestained (26619), Bis-Tris MES
ladders.note: The same ladder as 26619, apparent MW in NuPAGE Bis-Tris gels with MES running buffer (4-12 %, 10 %, 12 %). Lot-to-lot ~5 %.
ladders.source: Thermo Fisher user guide MAN0011773 Rev. C.01, migration table

ladders.name: PageRuler Plus Prestained (26619), Tris-acetate
ladders.note: The same ladder as 26619, apparent MW in NuPAGE Tris-acetate gels (3-8 %, 7 %); the 15 and 10 kDa bands run off. Lot-to-lot ~5 %.
ladders.source: Thermo Fisher user guide MAN0011773 Rev. C.01, migration table

ladders.name: Prestained Protein Molecular Weight Marker (26612)
ladders.note: Six blue native proteins (beta-galactosidase, BSA, ovalbumin, carbonic anhydrase, beta-lactoglobulin, lysozyme); sizes are approximate (~), shown for 8-16 % Tris-glycine SDS-PAGE. Mobility of prestained proteins varies between buffer systems; approximate MW only. Lot-to-lot ~5 %.
ladders.source: Thermo Fisher product information MAN0011770 Rev. C.00 (Prestained Protein Molecular Weight Marker)

ladders.name: PageRuler Unstained (26614)
ladders.note: Each protein 0.02-0.05 mg/ml in the vial; no per-band load values given.

ladders.name: Bio-Rad Precision Plus Protein Dual Color (1610374)
ladders.note: Product page confirms 10 proteins, 10-250 kD, pink reference bands at 25 and 75 kD; the individual sizes are not yet checked against the datasheet.

ladders.name: NEB ssRNA Ladder (N0362)
ladders.note: RNA, denaturing or native agarose gels. The 3000 nt band is at double intensity (reference). Not designed for mass quantification.

ladders.name: NEB Low Range ssRNA Ladder (N0364)
ladders.note: RNA, denaturing PAA-urea or agarose gels. The 300 nt band is at double intensity (reference). Not designed for mass quantification.

ladders.name: RiboRuler Low Range RNA Ladder (SM1831)
ladders.note: RNA ladder for native or denaturing gels.

ladders.name: NEB Lambda PFG Ladder (N0341)
ladders.note: Pulsed-field gels: concatemers of lambda DNA (48.5 kb steps).

ladders.name: NativeMark Unstained Protein Standard (LC0725)
ladders.note: Native (non-denaturing) protein gels. Migration in native gels depends on shape and charge, so sizes are estimates.
